messages:
Ana: Hey team — I'm consolidating hardware partner inputs for the cost model. Vega uploaded a CSV but it's missing a couple of cols we need: commitment windows (months), spot preempt stats by region, guaranteed minimum capacity per quarter, and billing cadence. Can @Mike @Chris weigh in on what else we should ask?

VegaPartner: Hi Ana — quick answer from our side. We can add the missing fields. Here's an example snippet of what we'll send (CSV):

```
sku,region,commit_months,reserved_price_per_hr,spot_median_price_per_hr,spot_p90_price_per_hr,spot_p10_price_per_hr,spot_eviction_pct,avg_eviction_minutes,guaranteed_min_gpus,billing_type,upfront_discount_pct,tiering_bucket
A100-80GB,us-west-2,12,4.80,1.20,1.80,0.90,6.2,12,20,monthly,5,0-99
H100-80GB,us-east-1,6,9.50,2.90,3.60,2.30,8.7,9,10,upfront,10,100-499
Q-A100,us-west-2,1,3.20,0.85,1.10,0.60,5.5,14,5,monthly,0,0-99
```

VegaPartner: Notes: spot_eviction_pct is historical over the last 90 days, avg_eviction_minutes is measured from preempt notice to reclaim in that region. Billing_type = "monthly" or "upfront". Upfront_discount_pct applies when customer prepays reserved commit.

Mike: This looks good. For the cost engine we also need: commit split buckets (12/6/1), p90/p10 bands for spot (you included), eviction window distribution (not just mean) ideally percentile e.g., p50/p90, and whether reserved pricing has scheduled step-downs during multi-year commits. Also: do you provide a committed-to-actual utilization signal (we can model expected utilization vs guaranteed)?

VegaPartner: We can add p50/p90 eviction mins and a column for scheduled step-downs (if any). For utilization signal we provide a historical utilization_ratio column (0-1) averaged per quarter. For multi-year step-downs we have CSV flags: step_down_month, step_down_pct.

Chris: Also need the invoice lag (days) and whether reserved is billed monthly vs annual vs amortized. And confirm whether tier discounts trigger on cumulative account usage or per-contract.

VegaPartner: invoice_lag_days and billing_amortization columns added. Tiering is per-customer account cumulative usage (not per single contract). We'll include a short legend in the file. We'll upload to the GCS folder and share link once done. :white_check_mark:

Ana: Great — please add these extra cols to the canonical CSV and include region->zone mapping (we need to simulate cross-zone fallback pricing). Also flag quantized/approx SKUs (Q-A100 above) — for those we need an approx_cost_multiplier rather than raw physical inventory.

VegaPartner: Will do. One heads-up: Q-A100 is a logical SKU; pricing is derived from A100 with a multiplier. We'll add approx_cost_multiplier and mapping: base_sku -> derived_sku. Example: approx_cost_multiplier=0.67 for Q-A100.

Mike: Perfect. For modeling, mark quantized SKUs explicitly and include a confidence score for spot price forecasting (0-1). We'll use that to weight scenario sampling.

VegaPartner: Adding confidence_score, tiering_buckets as arrays in the CSV cell (comma-delimited), and the step_down schedule. Also including 'commit_deadline_cutoff_utc' to know when pricing locks. Uploading now. cc @Chris for contractual terms.

Ana: Thanks everyone — I'll ingest the file into the cost model tomorrow, run sensitivity on eviction_pct and quantized multiplier, and flag any anomalies. Ping me if you see anything missing. :thumbsup:
